meta_description:
10K likes, 196 comments - casarthakahuja on September 25, 2026: "This week, I sat down with Mr. Bill Gates to discuss:

1/ If concerns around AI potentially killing humanity are real or just excuses to defer the IPOs of OpenAI and Anthropic?

2/ What Indians should build with AI on top of the foundational LLMs, to solve for problems in our country?

3/ What are opportunities to solve in healthcare, education, financial inclusion so that AI is an equalizer and not an amplifier of assymetries?

Watch this episode of Founder’s Office with Sarthak Ahuja on YouTube and Spotify.

Directed and Produced by Aditi Randev.

https://youtu.be/rxq9BMHUT_k".
